task.description:
Hard gate — validate TC-DDL-04-AC6 in tests/specs/DDL-04.md and tests/integration/ddl04_backfill_loop_test.zig.

Checks:
1. TC-DDL-04-AC6 is documented in DDL-04.md with correct Given/When/Then (status='applied', backfill_batch_size correct).
2. Implementation in ddl04_backfill_loop_test.zig is runnable (no SkipZigTest).
3. Fixture isolated: per-test data, defer cleanup.
4. ISS-0716 both ACs covered: backfill_batch_size persists adaptive value; terminal status written.
5. Test is self-sufficient.

Return PASS if all checks pass, FAIL with gaps otherwise.

result.summary: TC-DDL-04-AC6 fails Check 4: ISS-0716 AC1 (adaptive backfill_batch_size) is not covered. The test uses defaultConfig() so no halving fires and the adaptive batch size equals the initial default (5000). The assertion expectEqualStrings("5000", row[5]) is indistinguishable from the pre-fix state (hardcoded literal 5000 in recordBatchProgress) — it would pass whether or not the hardcoded-5000 defect was actually fixed. Terminal status (status='applied') is correctly asserted (Check 4 AC2 PASS). Checks 1, 2, 3, 5 all PASS.

issues.description: TC-DDL-04-AC6-loop-records-progress uses defaultConfig() (batch_timeout_ms not set → no halving). backfill_batch_size stays at 5000 throughout; the assertion expectEqualStrings("5000", row[5]) passes whether the implementation passes the adaptive variable or hardcodes the literal 5000. To cover ISS-0716 AC1 (adaptive value persists), a variant of TC-DDL-04-AC6 must use a halving-enabled config (e.g. batch_timeout_ms=1, as in TC-DDL-04-AC4 with ≥2 batches) and assert that plat_migration_state.backfill_batch_size reflects the halved value (e.g. 2500 or 1250) rather than the initial 5000.

result.next_action: Route back to TEST-DESIGNER for rework: add adaptive-halving variant to TC-DDL-04-AC6 (or extend TC-DDL-04-AC4 to also assert plat_migration_state.backfill_batch_size) so ISS-0716 AC1 is distinguishably verified.
